package baseposted

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"testing"
)

// Oracle of test/fixtures/finality/strictbrotli_double_fault1 (certen-sdk), the Base side: this package's decompress of the channel 0x01 || stream under
// the case's cap (the cap is a uint64 here). Run inside pkg/finality/baseposted of the validator at cbb6373:
//   FP_DF_DIR=<dir with *.br and cases_in.json> go test ./pkg/finality/baseposted -run TestFixPostedDoubleFaultBase -count=1
// It writes cases_go_base.json: [{id, channel}] with channel "err" or "ok:<length>:<first 8 bytes of sha256, hex>".
func TestFixPostedDoubleFaultBase(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("FP_DF_DIR")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Fatal("FP_DF_DIR is required")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "cases_in.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var in []struct {
		ID     string `json:"id"`
		Stream string `json:"stream"`
		Cap    uint64 `json:"cap"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &in); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	type outCase struct {
		ID      string `json:"id"`
		Channel string `json:"channel"`
	}
	var out []outCase
	for _, c := range in {
		s, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, c.Stream+".br"))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		res := "err"
		if b, err := decompress(append([]byte{1}, s...), c.Cap); err == nil {
			h := sha256.Sum256(b)
			res = "ok:" + strconv.Itoa(len(b)) + ":" + hex.EncodeToString(h[:8])
		}
		out = append(out, outCase{ID: c.ID, Channel: res})
	}
	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", " ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "cases_go_base.json"), append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
